body: This project was adopted into the Andromeda pipeline (`/andromeda-adopt` at `0f60502e`); its masters describe the code as built. Upstream DioxusLabs/blitz `main` was last merged at `29a439e05` (merge commit `895a134f2`, 2026-11-24), the next sync's merge base, an upstream sync merging DioxusLabs/blitz main with two parents, every upstream commit left out named with its reason; Taffy is 0.16 from crates.io, the workspace taking no git source; Dioxus is held at 0.7.3, the Dioxus 0.8 move kept out of the upstream take.

- Stand cue: `stand_flight_booker.rs` asserts the invalid-date cue (`invalid` class + `disabled` Book) without colour; `stand_accessibility_ids.rs` pins each lean task's Tab sequence (`focus_next_node` from the root element) against the shared table `tab_order` in the stand checks' shared module — CRUD's restated since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness to six stops, `back-btn`, `crud-filter`, `crud-list`, `crud-name`, `crud-surname`, `crud-create`, and the flight booker's to four, `back-btn`, `flight-type`, `flight-start`, `flight-book`, the two other tasks' unchanged and asserts the 14 stand controls' roles and non-empty names — and, since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions, that every interactive-role tree node of the four lean tasks reads a non-empty name (the nine roles of `INTERACTIVE_ROLES`; the CRUD list named `People` by `aria-label`), each `REGION_NAMES` row's name in the tree and the snapshot, and that the tree the shell hands the adapter (`Document::accessibility_tree` through `&dyn blitz_dom::Document`) equals `harness.doc.accessibility_tree()` node for node, with the same focus and root, every `author_id` on it the node's `element_id`; `stand_actionable_keys.rs` asserts every actionable element of the lean tasks and Home reads an author key (`DioxusDocument::unkeyed_actionable()` empty, in every state), with no `tabindex`, role or Tab-order change, and since 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep the three non-lean tasks too — Temperature Converter · Circle Drawer · Cells 0 · 0 · 0, in both layout modes and with Circle Drawer's dialog open, through nine author ids added by `id:` lines alone (until then 2 · 3 · 676), and the load page the stand serves reads none either (`stand_load_page`); the load page and Cells hold Tab-order, keyboard and contrast rows (`stand_keyboard`, `stand_contrast`, `stand_load_page`, `stand_cells_served`; `LOAD_TAB_ORDER` and `CELLS_TAB_ORDER` in the shared module beside `tab_order` and `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER`; a Tab order reached only after a state change, such as the order page with its failure shown, is stated as a local table of the keyboard check, not in the shared table), so SC 2.1.1 and 1.4.3 are asserted on the load page's `load-fetch` Button and on Cells' `cells-grid`; the elements that react to input and state no interactive role are counted and pinned as measured (`stand_non_lean_tasks`: 0 on the four lean tasks, Home and Temperature Converter, Cells 677, the 676 data cells and `cells-grid`) — the snapshot field `NodeState.clickable` (`NODE_FIELDS` fourteen) says that an element reacts to a click, read from the vdom walk's current `click` listeners on an element that is no disabled form control and not from the listener mark, that reading measured by `dioxus_runtime_probe`'s link 2 (in both layout modes, in the workspace `test` leg and in neither the `a11y` nor the `stand-repeat` leg), and `stand_non_lean_tasks` asserts a `CLICKABLE` table of the elements that read `clickable` and state no role, in both layout modes — Counter, Temperature Converter, Flight Booker, Timer and CRUD 0 each, Cells 676 — beside the listener mark's count, Cells 677; since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness SC 2.1.1 on the stand's buttons is met by measurement: `stand_keyboard.rs` reads Enter and Space on each focused stand button as its click (16 rows, `counter-increment`, `flight-book` and `crud-create` changing the screen; a focused single select such as the flight booker's `select#flight-type` instead opens its list on a pressed Enter, or a pressed Space with no typed text standing, and a released Space does nothing more), and through the driver `stand_act_keys.rs` presses `enter` and `space` on a Tab-focused `counter-increment`, each naming `counter-value`; since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions Enter and Space also read as the click of the two buttons enabled after boot, `crud-update` and `crud-delete`, each reached by keyboard alone (4 rows), and the Tab walk is asserted in two enabled states, each reached by keyboard alone, against the shared table `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER` — the flight booker after the return flight is chosen on `select#flight-type` by ArrowDown, five stops; CRUD after a row is selected, eight, `crud-update` and `crud-delete` last — every `controls(task)` id lying in `tab_order` ∪ `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER`.

- Stand checks live in `tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_{boot,counter,flight_booker,timer,crud,element_ids,id_persistence,accessibility_ids,snapshot,snapshot_state,snapshot_text,diff,id_edits,actionable_keys}.rs`, each building its harness through `stand::boot` (or `Harness::from_vdom` with `stand::options` — for a fixture page through the shared `fixtures::boot` of `tests/fixtures/mod.rs` — for Home, the edit fixtures, the state fixture — a checkbox, two radios and a password input the lean tasks lack — the text check's two fixtures, a password input and a file input, and the diff check's three — a panel hidden by attribute, a password input and a label a button rewrites) and driving it with the harness input helpers: `cargo test -p blitz-tests --test stand_boot` (etc.). They assert unconditionally under the bundled font — no font skip, no sleep, no `dispatch_recorded`. Since 2026-10-14-quality-gates the `stand-repeat` CI leg (not a fast leg) runs every `tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_*.rs`, one `--test` each, and, on the same line, named blitz-tests targets outside that prefix as literal `--test` words (`stand_requirement_sweep`'s `STAND_REPEAT_NAMED` still holding the first ten), each file keeping its name, in three rounds — a zero-failure budget, no retry, no `--ignored`. Each lean task's controls and value displays carry author `id`s (`counter-value`, `flight-book`, `timer-reset`, `crud-delete` …) that are their stable element ids — select them by `#id`; the pre-id checks still select by class and by structural selectors under `.crud-root`. Each CRUD row carries the Dioxus key `{person.id}`, its person's model-assigned `u64`, set on the `for` item itself with the filter in the iterator (a `key:` inside an `if` within the `for` would not key the list), and beside it the author `id` `crud-person-{person.id}` — so a row's id is `crud-person-0` · `-1` · `-2` on the fixture, Create from `crud-person-3`, and follows its person under filter, Create and Delete. Home's seven task cards carry `task-card-{slug}` (`counter`, `temp-converter`, `flight-booker`, `timer`, `crud`, `circle-drawer`, `cells`) — open a task with `#task-card-timer`. Every element an agent can act on must read an author key: `stand_actionable_keys` asserts `unkeyed_actionable()` empty on the four lean tasks and Home, so a new control there needs an `id`; since 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep the temp converter, circle drawer and cells read it empty too (2 · 3 · 676 until then), Circle Drawer's dialog open included — keyed by author ids added as `id:` lines alone, no element, class, style, wrapper or order moving: `temp-celsius` · `temp-fahrenheit`; `circle-undo` · `circle-redo` · `circle-canvas` and, only while its dialog is open, `circle-diameter` (the dialog's range input) · `circle-close`; `cell-{A..Z}{0..25}` on the 676 data cells through the file's own `col_label(c)` and `cell-input` on the one edit input and, beside those, `cells-grid` on the grid, focusable and carrying a listener, so it reads its key (`stand_non_lean_tasks` reads it). The six task inputs are named by attributes alone — `r#for` on the existing labels of `timer-duration` / `crud-filter` / `crud-name` / `crud-surname`, `aria_label` on `flight-start` ("Departure date") and `flight-return-date` ("Return date"). seven_guis takes dioxus-native with no `accessibility` feature, so `just seven_guis` builds no AccessKit adapter; since 2026-10-07-act-by-id it gets dioxus-native-dom's `accessibility` through its `escher-driver` edge, so both its binaries compile the `accessibility_tree` override and the snapshot modules — still with no adapter to hand a tree to. The driver-action checks `stand_act_{ids,diff,timer,refused,keys,range,disabled,obstructed,scroll,spans,filled,states,screenshot,transformed,select,popup}.rs` drive a held stand session through `escher_driver::Session::run`, by stable id, `stand_act_select` also run in the `a11y` CI leg (one of its named files); since 2026-10-12-headless-screenshot `stand_screenshot_repeat` checks a shot of one state byte-identical in two child runs and in the parent on one host, in both layout modes — a shot holding document text differs in PNG bytes between linux x86_64 and macOS aarch64, so a check compared byte for byte across OSes holds no `screenshot` step, save a canvas shot — three canvas-alone fixtures shot whole and as their element, and Circle Drawer's canvas shot as its element — held byte-equal on linux x86_64, windows x86_64 and macOS aarch64 by committed digest tables, no pixels committed; `stand_cross_os_readings` holds the seven served stand tasks' driver answer digests of snapshot, lint and actions the same on linux x86_64, windows x86_64 and macOS aarch64, in both layout modes, at boot and after one step, compared with no screenshot; since 2026-10-13-stand-contrast-harness `stand_contrast` (both layout modes, among its tests the load page's ratios and Cells' ratios; a stand check reading `tests/common/mod.rs`) reads the 17 `controls(task)` rows over the four lean tasks at boot through `Harness::text_contrast` against a stated record (pass 13 · fail 0 · exempt-inactive 3 · no-text 1 since the accent moved one step darker — pass 9 · fail 5 until then, the fifth former fail's control retired; `flight-type` `#1a1a1a` on `#ffffff` at 17.40 — exempt exactly where the snapshot's `enabled` reads `Some(false)`) and matches the painted background to the measured one within 1 per channel; since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions it also asserts every non-exempt control row, the CRUD list rows and the text outside the controls (`TEXT_ROWS`, 14, all pass) and the colour states it reaches, hover and active included (`STATE_ROWS`, 20: 19 pass, 1 exempt — with return chosen, `flight-type` and `flight-return-date` each 17.40), and runs in the `a11y` CI leg; since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness `stand_keyboard` (both layout modes, 11 until 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions, which added three and put it in the `a11y` CI leg, the fifteenth the flight type select moving its choice by its arrows, the sixteenth to the twenty-first the load page's stated walk with Enter and Space on its button, Cells' stated walk, Cells' arrows and Enter opening the moved-to cell and its value committed by keyboard, Tab leaving an open editor committing it, a click on another cell committing an open editor to its own cell, and the arrows clamping at the grid's ends and bringing a cell into view, those two walks stated by `LOAD_TAB_ORDER` and `CELLS_TAB_ORDER`, the twenty-second and twenty-third the flight type walk holding with its list open and after each close, and a click opening the list with focus staying on the select and the walk going on from it; the nineteenth stand check reading `tests/common/mod.rs`, whose `tab_order` table — CRUD six stops, `crud-list` third — `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER` table and `focused` helper it shares) walks each lean task's stated Tab and Shift+Tab sequence with wrap, the engine's focus, the snapshot's `focused` and the tree's focus agreeing at every step, reads Enter and Space on each focused stand button as its click and a click focusing each stand button, reads a `disabled` attribute skipping a form control on Tab and not a `<div disabled tabindex=0>`, checks the CRUD list taking focus and its keys moving the selection, and reads an inert subtree skipped by Tab; since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions it also walks beyond boot — the flight booker after `return` is chosen on `flight-type` (five stops, `flight-return-date` joining `back-btn` → `flight-type` → `flight-start` → `flight-book`, reached by Tab and ArrowDown) and CRUD after a row is selected (eight stops), each state reached by keyboard alone and walked in `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER` — checks every `controls(task)` id reached by Tab, and reads Enter and Space on the later-enabled `crud-update` and `crud-delete` each as its click. Since 2026-10-14-stand-requirement-sweep two more stand checks read `tests/common/mod.rs`: `stand_requirement_sweep` (both layout modes) holds every requirement through `Session::run` alone on each lean task and names each requirement's witness tests in `WITNESSES` (16 rows, each found in its file through `include_str!`) and `WITNESSES_020`, the 0.2.0 record (nine rows, 49 witnesses), read by its third test — a `Served` witness naming a check on a page the stand serves beside the lean four (Cells or the load page), a `Unit` witness naming a crate's unit test, run by the workspace `test` leg and outside `stand-repeat` by construction, every other witness read as inside `stand-repeat` by the `stand_` prefix or by its name anywhere in `ci-leg.sh`'s text, which the test reads whole by `contains` — so a witness dropped from `stand-repeat` alone while the `a11y` leg still names it still reads inside, the leg's membership held jointly with `test_stand_repeat_leg_runs_three_rounds`, and `stand_non_lean_tasks` (both layout modes) pins the per-task count of elements that react to input and state no role (0 on the four lean tasks, Home and Temperature Converter, Cells 677, its 676 data cells and `cells-grid` with its `onkeydown`) and the count of those whose snapshot reads `clickable` (`CLICKABLE`: Counter, Flight Booker, Timer, CRUD and Temperature Converter 0 each, Cells 676), the Circle Drawer dialog rule applying, and its open dialog read keyed. Since 2026-10-19-recorded-check-replay `stand_replay` (both layout modes, not unix-gated; a reader of `tests/session_common/mod.rs`) replays the two committed checks under `tests/blitz-tests/checks/` through `Check::replay`: each holding on a fresh stand Counter, each red at its first activation step (1 for the command line's check, 3 for the MCP role's) on a test-local variant `Counter` that adds 2, mounted in `TaskShell`, and a check on a session of another app running nothing. Since 2026-10-19-visual-lint `stand_lint` (both layout modes; a reader of `tests/session_common/mod.rs` and `tests/fixtures/mod.rs`) reads the stand through the visual lint (`Session::lint`, escher-driver, in process and as the `lint` verb on every carrier): at boot the counter, the flight booker, the timer and CRUD read 0 findings (`stand_lint`'s `at_boot` `[0, 0, 0, 0]`) in both layout modes, and the load page, the order page and Circle Drawer read 0 findings at boot too, through the verb as through the reader — `overlaps` skipping on either side an option of a closed drop-down and an open list's row or group, the snapshot giving a closed drop-down's option its select's client rect and an open list's row its own `bounds`, a list box's rows — a `multiple` select's or a single select's of display size above 1 — linted as usual and the pair of overlapping rows `stand_lint` plants reading exactly `fx-row-a` × `fx-row-b` — and after twelve Creates the last CRUD row, `crud-person-14`, reads `clipped`, its visible part 367 × 11.203125 inside `crud-list`, agreeing with the driver's `off-screen` refusal of its `click`; a node both clipped or off-screen and holding text also reads `truncated`, pinned by `stand_lint` in both layout modes, the `lint` verb answering the same; no stand markup, id, class or style moved. Two served-page checks (both layout modes, in `stand-repeat` by their `stand_` prefix, both reading `tests/session_common/mod.rs`): `stand_cells_served` holds Cells booted through `stand::boot_cells` as a session — its screen 53,859 bytes in 740 lines walked in 6 parts of `SNAPSHOT_TEXT_BUDGET`, committed cells reading their values, a cell past the viewport in the last part, a driver click right after a `scroll` advancing the virtual clock past the overlay scrollbar's fade first, so it is not taken as a thumb drag, the lint at boot reading its measured findings, and the keyboard walking to a cell and committing a value read in the first part — and `stand_load_page` the load page booted through `stand::boot_load` — a `click` on `load-fetch` waiting out its load and returning with `load-done` reading "Loaded", and the page keyed (`unkeyed_actionable()` empty) with no finding at boot. Since 2026-11-07-ui-graph `stand_graph` (both layout modes, in `stand-repeat` by its `stand_` prefix; a reader of `tests/session_common/mod.rs` and, the twenty-second, of `tests/common/mod.rs`, whose `GRAPH_DRIVES` drives each conditional write once) holds the `graph` verb's answer equal to `DioxusDocument::graph`, Counter's declared write read at boot and confirmed after a click, every graph node a snapshot node with no served id holding `///`, a graph read changing nothing and holding no typed text, and the Cells graph (293,869 bytes whole), past the 10,000-byte snapshot text budget, answered in parts of whole nodes within it, the states in part 1 alone. `stand_actions` (both layout modes, in `stand-repeat` by its `stand_` prefix; a reader of `tests/session_common/mod.rs`, `tests/fixtures/mod.rs` and, the twenty-third, of `tests/common/mod.rs`, whose `ACTIONABLE_AT_BOOT` holds the measured count of actionable nodes at boot per served task — counter 2, flight-booker 7, timer 3, crud 11, cells 678, load 2) lists each served screen's actionable nodes with the table's verbs and counts, every listed cause on the four lean tasks equal to what `Session::run` returns, 3 `disabled` controls among them, the stated Cells and load-page causes equal to what the call returns, the flight booker's two options read `covered` under their owner `flight-type` until the list opens, the last CRUD row `off-screen` until a `scroll`, the fixtures reading `covered`, unkeyed and `fonts-unavailable`, the read changing nothing and holding no typed text or mask, and the whole Cells answer (106,088 bytes for 678 nodes) within the answer bound.

It measured dioxus-native-dom line coverage falling from 91.14 % to 88.59 % against an unchanged 83 % floor; CI read 17 of 17 checks green and the capture checks held 0 needles.
